name: 28782-eagledecode-llama2-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B as the EAGLE draft head. The target is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf, under the Llama 2 Community License; the head shares the target's embedding and output projection, so it must be paired with these weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, MHA -- 32 query over 32 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, max_position_embeddings 4096. Draft: LlamaForCausalLMEagle, one decoder layer, same hidden size and vocab.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 8 requests/s, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1600 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 28782. Prompts 512 +- 128 tokens clamped to [256, 1024], generations 256 +- 64 clamped to [128, 512]. `ignore_eos` is sent, so every request generates its full sampled length. Radix cache is off, so every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant with draft-model accelerated replies, serving eight prompts per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped, and the engine would then start
# without something this file declares.

model-path: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
attention-backend: flashinfer
page-size: 1
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 8
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.80
disable-radix-cache: true
chat-template: llama-2
